# GroundApp

> GroundApp offers check-ins with Bodie and guided breathing on iPhone and Apple Watch. Free to download, with a free tier and optional Premium. Current inclusions, local price and any trial eligibility are shown in the app before purchase. GroundApp is coaching and education, not medical or mental health treatment. Website: https://groundapp.live/

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/groundapp-breathwork/id6760352779
- Requires iOS 17 or later. The Apple Watch app requires watchOS 11 or later.
- Create an account when you start, with Apple, Google or email. You can delete it in Settings.

## Pricing

- Free to download, with a free tier and optional Premium. No fixed catalog or free-technique count is promised.
- Published US Premium pricing is $39.99 a year or $6.99 a month. The store confirms local price, inclusions and any eligible trial before purchase. Apple subscriptions renew unless cancelled through Apple.

## Features

- Breathing techniques with practice guides
- Check in with Bodie: name how you feel and get breathwork matched to it
- Advanced O2 and CO2 tables for breath-hold training (dry land only)
- Guided sessions in Collin's voice, with ambient sound and haptic cues (Premium)
- Guided meditations
- Guided sessions use an AI model of Collin's voice, trained on his recordings; haptic-only mode is available
- Live heart rate and HRV from a Bluetooth heart rate monitor or a Whoop or Garmin broadcasting heart rate
- Apple Health, plus Whoop, Garmin, Oura and COROS through Apple Health
- Apple Watch app
- Streaks and session history. Sample progress screens are not user outcomes.
- Current free inclusions and Premium features are shown in the app before purchase.

## Free game

- [Bodie's Breath Run](https://groundapp.live/play): a free browser game with finger and keyboard controls, screen shields, jumps and a noncompetitive ribbon ride. Breathe normally. No maximal-hold mode, physiological score or dive challenge. Game records use a new browser-only namespace, separate from the removed breath-hold records.

## Use Cases

- Calming down in a stressful moment
- Winding down for sleep
- Focus and composure before a performance, presentation or competition
- Energy in the morning or before training
- Building a daily breathwork habit

## Safety and scope

- This is coaching and education, not medical or mental health treatment.
- Advanced breath-hold tables: Dry land only. Never in or near water.
- Wearable readings inform suggestions. They are not a medical assessment.
